candidate_claims.text: | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement Prime Minister Narendra Modi will virtually inaugurate a restored British-era Vellore Cantonment railway station on October 11, during his visit to the State.
The station is located next to a 16th century fort complex in Vellore town.
Modi will inaugurate the station through video conferencing from Chennai, where he is expected to inaugurate various completed works of the Southern Railway in the State.

Railway officials said that the restoration work, which was started in 2023, was being done under the station redevelopment project, which aims to provide better passenger amenities, including separate arrival and departure corridors, bright LED lights, hassle-free access to platforms through escalators, lifts, skywalks and a rainwater harvesting system.
A total of 25 granite benches on the platforms were refurbished.

items.title: PM’s address at the Centenary Celebrations of UPSC

candidate_claims.text: The manner in which India’s Captain Smita displayed patience, prudence, and courage, and as the Prime Minister of Israel said today, this Indian prevented another 9/11 from taking place.
Friends, Today is not only a celebration of 100 years of the UPSC, but also a celebration of a legacy.
A commemorative postage stamp and coin marking this 100-year journey have just been released.
A compilation of 100 important case laws has also been published.
A little while ago, I was visiting the gallery that has been set up here, and I would encourage all of you to spend 10 to 15 minutes exploring it.
I noticed a photograph from the 75th anniversary celebrations in which Lt.
Today, at the age of 90, he is present among us.
While looking through the gallery, I noticed that it also contains information about how Subhas Chandra Bose went through this very process in 1920.
candidate_claims.context_before: Every one of them deserves appreciation and recognition.

candidate_claims.text: The steel frame that was required for the reconstruction of the nation was provided by Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
Friends, When the foundation of this institution was laid in 1926, the priorities of that era were different.
Much has already been said from this stage about its achievements and contributions.
Therefore, I neither wish to repeat those points nor go into detail about them.
One quarter of the 21st century, twenty-five years, has already passed.
Friends, India in 2047 will be very different from the India of today.

Friends, Many of you are familiar with the fact that whenever I meet trainee officers, I ask them to write down, right at the beginning and in their own handwriting, why they have joined the civil service.
In other words, the citizen of this country is no less than a deity for us.
Service to the citizen is our highest priority.
We are all familiar with the global debate currently taking place around AI.
It is connected not only to an event but to the future and lives of young people.
In fact, while I was looking at the gallery, I noticed that nearly one hundred days have already been reduced.
One objective of these conferences is to help one state learn about, understand, and, where appropriate, adopt the best practices of another state.
To make this conference broader, more productive, and richer in new ideas, I am sure you are continuously thinking about giving it a new shape and a new dimension.
When UPSC was established, opportunities were more readily available to young people from large cities, economically privileged families, and prestigious institutions.
In 1952, women constituted only 3 percent of candidates in the civil services, just three percent.
Today that figure has risen to more than 30 percent.

candidate_promises.text: This will provide significant assistance to young people.
